synopsis: Mutual information measures how much knowing one image tells you about another and is useful for radar maps [f14772]. Chapter 6 lists it among distribution-level similarity metrics for sensor-model validation, alongside FID, KID, texture and entropy measures [f4803]. RadaRays’ physics-based radar model dramatically improved mutual-information and structural-similarity scores relative to a lidar-like model [f4824]. However, a detector trained only on real radar data still failed to detect most cars in the simulated images, showing that improved similarity scores did not establish successful detector transfer [f14776, f14793].
